Second Sunday of Advent

Second Sunday of Advent: A Day of Faith and Preparation

Celebrate the Second Sunday of Advent by embracing faith and community through meaningful traditions and comforting foods as Christmas approaches.

  1. Morning

    Light the Second Advent Candle

    Begin your day by lighting the second candle on your Advent wreath to symbolize faith and reflect on the prophets who foretold Christ's coming.

  2. Late Morning

    Read Scripture about John the Baptist

    Gather your family or household to read passages from the Bible focusing on John the Baptist, emphasizing his role in preparing the way for Jesus.

  3. Noon

    Prepare Cardamom Buns and Spiced Tea

    Bake fragrant cardamom buns and brew spiced tea to enjoy together as a warm, inviting midday treat that comforts and uplifts.

    Recipes: Cardamom Buns · Spiced Tea

  4. Afternoon

    Charity and Kindness

    Set aside time to collect donations or prepare care packages for neighbours in need, embodying the Advent spirit of generosity and community support.

  5. Early Evening

    Bake Cinnamon Star Cookies

    Create cinnamon star cookies as a festive activity that brings the household together, filling your home with seasonal aromas and sweet anticipation.

    Recipes: Cinnamon Star Cookies

  6. Evening

    Enjoy a Hearty Casserole Dinner

    Conclude the day with a warm, nourishing casserole that provides comfort during the contemplative Advent evening.

    Recipes: Hearty Beef and Root Vegetable Casserole

  7. Sundown

    Reflective Closing

    End your day with a quiet moment of reflection on faith and hope as you prepare your heart for the coming Christmas season.

May this day of faith, reflection, and kindness deepen your Advent anticipation and bring warmth to your home.
